patthana16.8:1.1: abyākato sanidassano dhammo na abyākatassa na sanidassanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. na kusalassa na sanidassanassa …pe… cha pañhā kātabbā.
patthana16.8:2.1: kusalaṃ sanidassanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na akusalo na anidassano dhammo-. (akusalena tīṇimeva) (abyākatena tīṇimeva) nava.
